TurnOnOff.MouseButton1Down:connect(function()

while _G.Farm do

    for i,v in pairs(game.Workspace.Tokens:GetChildren()) do
       if v:IsA("MeshPart") and v.Transparency == 0 then
          game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position = v.Position
       end
    end
end
end)
